guard: Prepare releases only its exact validation-only policy hold, preserves denial and CAS failure causes, and retains every attempted reservation write under uncertain custody.

mutations.name: validation-only prepare denial retains the policy head
mutations.find:
try { await hold.release(); }
        catch (releaseError) { throw new AggregateError([error, releaseError], "prepare validation refused and policy release failed", { cause: error }); }
mutations.replace:
try { /* mutation: omit validation-only release */ }
        catch (releaseError) { throw new AggregateError([error, releaseError], "prepare validation refused and policy release failed", { cause: error }); }

mutations.name: failed prepare policy release discards the original denial
mutations.find: throw new AggregateError([error, releaseError], "prepare validation refused and policy release failed", { cause: error });

mutations.name: ambiguous first reservation write releases its policy hold
mutations.replace: try { await createRowByteIdempotent(authKv, reservationKey(instanceId), row); } catch (error) { await hold.release(); throw error; }

mutations.name: successful validation-only release replaces the original denial object
mutations.find:
catch (releaseError) { throw new AggregateError([error, releaseError], "prepare validation refused and policy release failed", { cause: error }); }
        throw error;
mutations.replace:
catch (releaseError) { throw new AggregateError([error, releaseError], "prepare validation refused and policy release failed", { cause: error }); }
        throw new Error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
